nodes.label: Signature Component: Answer Navigator
nodes.rationale: 10-column tabular mono grid of square cells showing muted default, solid ink answered, sign-gold marked, and sign-blue current ring.

nodes.label: Signature Component: CEFR Band Bar
nodes.rationale: Six bands (<A1 to C1) proportional to real score ranges inside a 2px ink frame.

nodes.label: Signature Component: The State Block
nodes.rationale: Empty, error, and blocked screens use a word stamp in a painted box (EMPTY, FAILED, EXPIRED, BLOCKED) with a sentence-case condensed bold title.

nodes.norm_label: mandatory forui ui library reference rule
nodes.rationale: Agents must consult forui-llms.txt and forui-llms-full.txt before coding any UI, widget, or theme.

nodes.label: ADR 0001: Flutter Client Stack and Exam-Hall Signage Theme
nodes.norm_label: adr 0001: flutter client stack and exam-hall signage theme
nodes.rationale: Adopts flutter_riverpod, dio, flutter_secure_storage, go_router, and forui locked to the Exam-Hall Signage (Bảng hiệu phòng thi) zero-radius, zero-shadow, 2px Ink keyline aesthetic and self-hosted IBM Plex typography.

nodes.label: Exam-Hall Signage Design System (Bảng hiệu phòng thi)
nodes.norm_label: exam-hall signage design system (bang hieu phong thi)
nodes.rationale: Refuses pale-blue SaaS card grids with soft shadows; uses flat painted fields, 2px Ink keylines, 1px soft interior rules, zero border radius, zero elevation/shadow, and solid Ink inversion.

nodes.label: IBM Plex Superfamily Typography (Sans, Sans Condensed, Mono)
nodes.norm_label: ibm plex superfamily typography (sans, sans condensed, mono)
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted Latin and Vietnamese subsets split functionally: Sans for reading, Condensed uppercase for signage chrome, and Mono tabular numerals for figures that must not jitter.

nodes.label: The Inversion Rule
nodes.rationale: Active or selected state inverts to a solid ink block (#14181d) with white lettering rather than tinting.

nodes.label: The One Flat Field & Keyline-Not-Blur Rules
nodes.norm_label: the one flat field & keyline-not-blur rules
nodes.rationale: No gradient, shadow, or blur; depth is carried by 2px ink outer frames and 1px soft interior dividers.

nodes.label: The Square-Corner & Dashed-Means-Unfilled Rules
nodes.rationale: Every border-radius is 0; dashed keylines are reserved exclusively for unfilled placeholders and drop zones.

nodes.label: Server-Authoritative Time, Answers, and Balance Principle
nodes.norm_label: server-authoritative time, answers, and balance principle
nodes.rationale: Server owns expiresAt deadline, immediate ~400ms answer saves, correct answers/explanations (withheld during exam), and credit balance.

nodes.label: Insight (AI Narrative)
nodes.rationale: Regenerated only when its inputs change; reads SQL-computed weakness analysis numbers.

nodes.label: Practice Session
nodes.rationale: Free drill graded immediately without AI (or recorded ungraded for pool productive tasks), bounded to a 20-session FIFO window per certificate for predictable storage.

nodes.label: Weakness Analysis
nodes.rationale: Per-section and per-category accuracy computed by SQL views rather than AI.

nodes.label: IngestionWorkbenchService.ClearForServiceAsync (ADM-02 / CNT-42)
nodes.rationale: Promotes item from validated to active under pool.content.review.

nodes.label: Item Lifecycle (CNT-42)
nodes.rationale: Six states (draft, validated, active, quarantined, retired, retired_defective); draft -> active is unreachable so unjudged items cannot become servable.

nodes.label: Target Backend Stack (.NET 10, EF Core, ASP.NET Core Web API, SQL Server)
nodes.norm_label: target backend stack (.net 10, ef core, asp.net core web api, sql server)

nodes.label: Audio Slicing
nodes.rationale: When a listening section has a master track uploaded in Exam Studio, every question group plays its own start/end slice of that master track.

nodes.label: Certificate
nodes.rationale: An English qualification (TOEIC, IELTS, VSTEP) defined entirely by data rather than hardcoded exam types.

nodes.label: Ledger
nodes.rationale: Append-only list of credit movements per learner; balance is always its sum, never a stored column.

nodes.label: Backend Reference Domain Context & Ubiquitous Language
nodes.norm_label: backend reference domain context & ubiquitous language

nodes.label: Phase 1 Mobile Learner Port Scope
nodes.rationale: Phase 1 ports only the streamlined Mobile Learner app without modifying the .NET backend.

nodes.label: Domain Documentation Convention (GLOSSARY.md & docs/adr/)
nodes.rationale: Engineering skills must consume GLOSSARY.md vocabulary without drifting to avoided synonyms and explicitly flag ADR conflicts.

nodes.label: Schema-Enforced Certificate Isolation
nodes.rationale: Composite foreign keys carry CertId down so exams, sections, rubric scores, and path items cannot leak across certificates.

nodes.label: Credit Monetisation & Append-Only Ledger Rules
nodes.rationale: Exactly five debit reasons (mock_exam_start, placement_retake, ai_grading, mentor_booking, premium_path) and two refund/grant reasons (booking_cancel, admin_grant); wallet balance is always SUM over ledger.

nodes.label: Multi-Certificate Companion Architecture Pivot
nodes.rationale: Pivoted from TOEIC-only high-stakes exam with KYC to a data-driven multi-certificate (TOEIC, IELTS, VSTEP) companion with free practice/first-placement and paid mocks, AI grading, mentor bookings, and premium paths.

nodes.label: FButton (primary, secondary, outline, destructive, ghost, link, icon, raw)
nodes.norm_label: fbutton (primary, secondary, outline, destructive, ghost, link, icon, raw)

nodes.label: payOS Redirect Gateway & PaymentEvents Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Grants credits only on signature-verified webhook or server status query, never on return redirect; enforces one open/reconciling order per account.

nodes.label: Asynchronous Speaking Practice & AI Grading Contract
nodes.norm_label: asynchronous speaking practice & ai grading contract
nodes.rationale: Uploads recorded audio per question to FreeResponses, queues AiGradings worker to transcribe and score against SectionCriteria asynchronously.

nodes.label: Lesson
nodes.rationale: Grammar micro-learning unit in a module comprising 6-10 swipeable cards with free in-card practice.

nodes.label: Placement Attempt
nodes.rationale: Seeds a learning path; first sitting per certificate per learner is free, while retakes charge credits by scope via placement_retake.
